final: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT z.city, COUNT(*) AS n FROM attendance AS a JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member JOIN zip_code AS z ON z.zip_code = m.zip GROUP BY z.city), city_ratios AS (SELECT city, n, 1.0 * n / SUM(n) OVER () AS ratio FROM city_counts), avg_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM city_ratios), filtered AS (SELECT c.n, c.ratio, c.ratio - a.avg_ratio AS difference FROM city_ratios AS c CROSS JOIN avg_ratio AS a WHERE c.ratio > a.avg_ratio) SELECT AVG(n), AVG(ratio), AVG(difference) FROM filtered
